title: Trump’s $100,000 H-1B fee ruled unlawful
summary_en: The Massachusetts court decision goes against a previous ruling upholding the $100,000 H-1B fee, with a third lawsuit still to be heard.
author: Polly Nash

title: Warwick and Reading rebrand foundation and language provision as Global Academies
summary_en: The University of Warwick and the University of Reading have both rebranded their language and foundation studies operations as Global Academies, reflecting a wider rethink of how universities support international students and where those functions sit within institutions.
author: The PIE News team
title_cn: Warwick and Reading rebrand foundation and language provision as Global Academies

title: Southern Cross offers TAFE graduates fast-track route into university degrees
summary_en: Southern Cross University has become the latest Australian institution to offer TAFE graduates a quicker and cheaper route into higher education, with eligible students able to enter directly into the second year of selected degrees.
author: Kim Martin
title_cn: Southern Cross offers TAFE graduates fast-track route into university degrees

title: India’s largest listed edtech reverses course on student lending
summary_en: PhysicsWallah has abandoned plans to lend directly through its finance arm, opting instead for partnerships with regulated lenders in a move the company says will reduce risk.
author: Abhishek Nair
title_cn: India’s largest listed edtech reverses course on student lending

title: Canada risks losing ground as rivals invest in higher education
summary_en: A newly released 2026 world university ranking saw all but one Canadian institution lose ground to global competitors, as experts warn of the “financial crunch" facing Canada’s higher education sector.
author: Polly Nash
title_cn: Canada risks losing ground as rivals invest in higher education

title: Why are TNE approvals surging in China?
summary_en: China's Ministry of Education approved 219 new Transnational Education (TNE) partnerships in its latest approval round at the end of May, the highest annual level of approvals since 2012 according to sector analysts.
author: Timothy van Gardingen
title_cn: Why are TNE approvals surging in China?

title: Japan’s study abroad landscape shifts as short-term mobility grows
summary_en: Japan's outbound student mobility remains below pre-pandemic levels as rising costs drive shorter study abroad experiences and shifting destination preferences.
author: Abhishek Nair
title_cn: Japan’s study abroad landscape shifts as short-term mobility grows

title: The PIE investigates: The real cost of rejection in visa fees
summary_en: The UK collected more than £9.3 million in visa fees over the last 12 months from students who were ultimately refused entry. The PIE investigates how the government is generating more income from visa refusals since 2012, despite falling application levels.
author: Nicholas Cuthbert and Dave Amor
title_cn: The PIE investigates: The real cost of rejection in visa fees

title: ICEF launches new agent information tool to increase transparency
summary_en: ICEF has launched a new Appointed Agent Locator tool to help institutions publish crucial information on their websites about who they use to recruit international students.
author: Beth Kennedy
title_cn: ICEF launches new agent information tool to increase transparency
